description: Read an identified passage, complete source group, section or recorded work version. Supports continued reading and adjacent-source navigation. Supply exactly one source identifier; work_id also requires language.

context.description: For a current passage target, include adjacent passage positions on each side, from 0 to 3.
context.title: Context

cursor.description: Continue from next_cursor, keeping all other arguments unchanged.
cursor.title: Cursor

direction.description: Select current, next or previous content. Passage targets navigate adjacent passages; group targets navigate adjacent groups or ungrouped passages. Navigation stays within the enclosing section, or text version where no section is mapped. Section and work-version targets use current.
direction.title: Direction

language.description: Recorded language value to select with work_id, such as ar, en or fa. Use und for unknown-language or mul for mixed-language occurrences.
language.title: Language

limit.description: Maximum passages per page, from 1 to 5. A passage target returns one selected passage plus requested context.
limit.title: Limit

occurrence_id.description: Read a work version listed in returned work metadata, within its recorded source boundaries.
occurrence_id.title: Occurrence Id

section_id.description: Read this source section in order, including its headings.
section_id.title: Section Id

text_chars.description: Maximum Unicode characters per passage slice: 1–12,000 for passage targets; 1–4,000 for other targets.
text_chars.title: Text Chars

text_start.description: Starting Unicode character offset for a passage target. Defaults to 0.
text_start.title: Text Start

unit_id.description: Read this complete source group, such as a Q&A pair or multi-paragraph extract.
unit_id.title: Unit Id

work_id.description: Read a catalogued work in the requested language, using its default eligible source version. Supply language. If several versions qualify, the result lists the choices.
work_id.title: Work Id

name: read_text
